title: A Well for the Portrait
author: Emrys Montrose
blurb: Wendell Thornbury, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
